name: run root
why: Each side has its own temporary directory.

name: oracle directory
why: The shared build and fixture directory of one run.

name: machine
why: This machine's host name and Node directory. Not product output.

name: scratch database
why: Each side has its own scratch database.

name: build revision
why: The two sides are different commits by definition.

name: instance secret
why: Generated per database. Also keeps credentials out of reports.

name: loopback port
why: Each instance listens on a free port.

name: agent id
why: Random, also inside default branch, directory and reviewer names. Agents the scenario created are numbered by creation, those Dispatch launched by first appearance in a step.

name: uuid
why: Random. Numbered by first appearance in a step, so references in that step still have to agree.

name: timestamp
why: Clock.

name: file name timestamp
why: Stored file names contain the clock.

name: fixture session id
why: The fixture adapter names sessions by the clock.

name: epoch milliseconds
why: Clock, in the two fields that use numbers for it.

name: duration
why: Timing is outside what the oracle can see (E7).

name: process id
why: Process identity in signed update responses.

name: database oid
why: Each side has its own scratch database.

name: image change token
why: Inode and file times. Whether the field is there is still compared.

name: checkout state id
why: A hash over the temporary path and inode. Whether the field is there is still compared.

name: checkout state id in text
why: The same hash, inside a review briefing.

name: task and column id
why: Random. Numbered by first appearance in a step.
